global_policies.snapshot: no observation dated after snapshot_at may be used
global_policies.missing: absence is distinct from zero and not_applicable
global_policies.provenance: every value retains release, observation, formula and transformation
forbidden: communal risk converted to parcel exposure

features.name: local_land_value_level
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: weighted median price/m2 of included land comparables
features.missing_value: absent when no decomposable accepted land comparable exists

features.name: exit_value_estimate_range
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: weighted comparable lower/upper quantiles times explicit scenario surface
features.missing_value: absent without sufficient comparables or scenario surface

features.name: comparable_count
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: count of included explainable comparables
features.missing_value: zero only after accepted source coverage and an executed selection

features.name: market_dispersion
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: interquartile range of included normalized prices
features.missing_value: absent with fewer than four comparable prices

features.name: market_liquidity_proxy
features.subject: MarketArea
features.formula: recent included transaction count / observable local stock
features.missing_value: absent when observable stock is unknown; never inferred as zero

features.name: comparable_sale_price_m2
features.subject: Building
features.formula: recency- and distance-weighted median of included comparable price/m2
features.missing_value: absent when no usable comparable exists

features.name: comparable_count
features.subject: Building
features.formula: count of included explainable comparables
features.missing_value: zero only after accepted source coverage and an executed selection

features.name: comparable_dispersion
features.subject: Building
features.formula: interquartile range of included price/m2
features.missing_value: absent with fewer than four comparable prices

features.name: transaction_recency
features.subject: Building
features.formula: median age in months of included comparables at snapshot
features.missing_value: absent without included comparables

features.name: local_price_trend
features.subject: MarketArea
features.formula: robust annualized median-price trend with minimum count and time span
features.missing_value: absent when historical support is insufficient

features.name: construction_period
features.subject: Building
features.formula: best non-predicted observed period or interval
features.missing_value: absent when no observation exists

features.name: building_area_proxy_m2
features.subject: Building
features.formula: best observed area, explicitly labelled as proxy when applicable
features.missing_value: absent when no observed or declared proxy exists

features.name: building_height_floors_consistency
features.subject: Building
features.formula: observed height / observed floors plausibility check
features.missing_value: not_applicable when either observation is absent

features.name: energy_label_observed
features.subject: Building
features.formula: label of latest valid deposited DPE resolved to building
features.missing_value: absence is neutral; ambiguous address-level DPE remains absent

features.name: energy_consumption_observed
features.subject: Building
features.formula: conventional consumption from selected deposited DPE
features.missing_value: absence is neutral

features.name: dpe_age_months
features.subject: Building
features.formula: complete months from assessment date to snapshot
features.missing_value: absent without selected deposited DPE

features.name: envelope_characteristics
features.subject: Building
features.formula: declared envelope fields from selected deposited DPE
features.missing_value: absent when fields are not declared

features.name: dpe_match_confidence
features.subject: Building
features.formula: confidence of exact DPE-address-building resolution
features.missing_value: absence reduces confidence only and never attractiveness

features.name: urban_zone_code
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: representative overlap with opposable zone at snapshot
features.missing_value: absent for missing, expired or materially ambiguous zone

features.name: zone_rule_profile
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: manually validated structured profile for exact document version and zone
features.missing_value: absent unless manually validated; free text is never interpreted

features.name: known_constraint_overlap
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: typed constraint count and intersection area
features.missing_value: zero overlap only when accepted complete coverage exists

features.name: residual_footprint_proxy_m2
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: geometric proxy after all indispensable validated structured rules
features.missing_value: absent until indispensable rules are complete and validated

features.name: urban_rule_completeness
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: validated required rules / required rules
features.missing_value: absent without an applicable exact document version

features.name: clay_exposure_2026
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: parcel/zone RGA 2026 observation intersecting unit
features.missing_value: communal observation is context only, never parcel exposure

features.name: flood_overlap
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: typed overlap with available flood zones
features.missing_value: absence distinct from known zero overlap

features.name: soil_pollution_proximity
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: SIS intersection or distance to covered known point sites
features.missing_value: absent when geometry or coverage is unavailable

features.name: cavity_proximity
features.subject: PropertyUnit
features.formula: distance to covered recorded cavities
features.missing_value: absent when point coverage is unknown

features.name: renovation_risk_profile
features.subject: Building
features.formula: explainable list of applicable fine-grained and contextual risk observations
features.missing_value: preserve unknown coverage and source granularity
